div.div: مَصَارّ [app. an irregular pl. of مَصِيرٌ, and therefore without tenween,] The أَمْعَآء [or guts, bowels, or intestines, into which the food passes from the stomach]. (M, K.) One says, شَرِبَ حَتَّى مَلَأَ مَصَارَّهُ, meaning [He drank until he filled] his أَمْعَآء: mentioned by AHn on the authority of IAar, with no more explanation than this. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
